title: Fix Natural Aim Micro Input
objective: Prevent tiny mouse movements from overpowering Natural Aim Assist while preserving deliberate manual pull-away.
acceptance_criteria: Single-frame micro mouse deltas do not cancel a committed target.
Small opposing input only weakens assistance rather than dropping the target.
Meaningful sustained opposing movement still disengages aim assistance promptly.
Regression simulations cover micro input, accumulated pull-away, recovery, and normal toward-target movement.
Minecraft 26.2 Java 25 build and runtime smoke test pass.
